title: Tim Drake as Saint Mary
alt: Digital illustration of a modern character against a grey background with a bright, pale yellow, round stained-glass rosetta behind their head, as if a halo. The character is shown knees-up, in an relaxed pose. He is smiling gently and is looking at the viewer. He is dressed in white, loose t-shirt and pants, and has blue bathrobe hanging from the back of his head by the hood. He is holding a red hairbrush in his right hand.
caption: commissioned illustration for my fanfic 'deus ex homine', 2023

title: AI Tim
alt: Digital portrait of a modern character against a black background. It is a close-up, so only the eyes are visible. He has light skin and black hair, and blue eyes that glow in the implied darkness. To the right of the characters are the words 'That's a story that will seem rather... weird to you'.
caption: fanart for my fanfic 'Our capacity for love increases with each person we cross paths with', 2021

title: young Jason Todd, from AI Tim's perspective
alt: Digital illustration intending to mimick the perspective of a security camera feed. The picture is surrounded by dark blue vingette and the round inside is distorted with a fisheye view. In the feed, young Jason Todd is sititng at a desk and giving the viewer/camera thumbs-up. He is smiling, and his face and fingers are covered in several bandaids. Behind him, there are bookshelves and a window.
caption: fanart for my fanfic 'Our capacity for love increases with each person we cross paths with', 2022

title: meahwile, the wild geese
alt: Digital illustration depicting a rooftop-view of an American city with scyscrapers in the background and lower brick buildings closer to the viewer. It's early morning, the sky is clear and there's a key of geese flying across it. On the rooftop closest to viewer, Jason Todd, in a leather jacket and red hoodie, with his red helmet next to him, is sitting over the edge of the roof, preparing to eat a hotdog. On a nearby roof, Nightwing is standing and waving at him. Jason is looking at NIghtwing, and his expression is unsure or slightly annoyed.
caption: fanart for my fanfic 'You do not have to be good ', 2022
